title: Prospective Study of Colonoscopic Resection of Large Polyps and Flat Lesions
brief_summary: With this study, the investigators plan to review the performance of colonoscopic resection of large (\> 1 cm) and flat lesions in the colon. The findings will help us define the role of colonoscopic resection of colon polyps and flat lesions and identity areas for improvement. The data will be used for continuing quality improvement and presenting our outcomes at academic meetings and publishing our results in peer reviewed journals.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1\. All Patients who have been referred for endoscopic resection of large polyps (\>1 cm) and flat lesions.

Exclusion Criteria:

N/A
study_population: Patients undergoing endoscopy at MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, Texas
